description: This file defines a PHP class 'Smarty_Template_Config' which extends 'Smarty_Template_Source' to handle Smarty template configuration resources. It includes properties for configuration sections, scope, class names for compilation, lexing, and parsing, and a static method 'load' to initialize source objects for configuration template resources.

classes.name: Smarty_Template_Config
classes.description: A data object representing Smarty template configuration resources, providing properties for configuration sections, scope, class names for compilation, lexing, and parsing, and a static load method to initialize configuration source objects.

methods.name: load
methods.description: A static method for initializing a Smarty_Template_Config object based on a given template, Smarty object, and resource string. It handles resource parsing, validation, and populates the source object accordingly.
